summary.intent: Coordinate and land a set of monokl PRs (#105-#108, release #97) using delegated subagents, including validating the name-boost ranking change in #108 and handling a new review finding and branch conflict on #105.
summary.outcome: #108 was judged merge-ready after a blind review (37 better, 4 worse, 7 equal) and a failed formula-fix experiment confirmed the tradeoff is structural. A fix for the quadratic lossy_offset finding was delegated to the #105 agent; the finding remains open and the branch conflict was just being investigated.

repo: monokl has `just` recipes: lint, test, doc-check, changesets, rg-compare, bench; scripts/bench.py can substitute for the bench recipe.
Changesets are required; ranking changes that alter scores/order but not signatures are classified minor.
The harness only checks whether the expected declaration is in the top 3, so it cannot judge whether a changed first row is better or worse; blind review is needed for that.

Name-boost tradeoff is structural: a declaration whose full name equals one query word outranks a better multi-word match (fd `batch`, tokio `interval`, react-hook-form cases), but fixing it loses `useWatch`, `toJSONSchema` (zod) and `Sse`.
The four regression cases are kept in the harness so future formulas are checked against them.
Review findings are tracked and resolved through `entire trail finding resolve`, to be run only after the fix is pushed.
PR #107 was stacked on #105 and has been merged into feat/span-hit-ownership, so #105 carries both PRs' changes.

code.finding: Finding 01M7EHV2JDKP: lossy_offset is quadratic because it rescans the line per match. The fix is a single forward pass over sorted offsets, verified with counted-visit tests at 1x/2x/4x line lengths and a proptest using the old function as an oracle.

workflow: Subagent reports are not user authority; verify state with GitHub/CLI before declaring something done or resolved.
Use blind, randomized-order comparison with a fixed seed and verdicts written before unblinding to judge ranking changes.
Run a bounded prototype experiment with hard constraints before changing a formula, and revert it if no variant qualifies.
Do not resolve findings before the fix is pushed, since that hides unfixed problems.
`git fetch` was blocked for the reviewer, so it compared local origin/main with the feature branch.

friction: `git fetch` was blocked in the reviewer subagent, so builds used possibly stale local refs.
Agent completion notices repeat reports already relayed, adding noise.
The #105 branch conflict plus a new finding landed after #107 was merged into it, complicating the merge order.
`just bench` was not run as a recipe; the agent substituted scripts/bench.py.
open_items: Fix the quadratic lossy_offset finding on #105, audit other per-match line rescans, merge main, push, then resolve the finding.
Confirm #105 is mergeable and its finding resolved on GitHub.
Review order remaining: #106, #105, #107, #108, then release PR #97.
Future work on the name-boost formula to address the 4 known regressions without losing useWatch, toJSONSchema or Sse.
